lead.event: TRUK shares surge and IDX suspends trading
lead.headline: TRUK shares surge 87.1% as IDX suspends trading
lead.blurb: Guna Timur Raya shares climbed from Rp3,220 to Rp6,025 over 19-23 October, making them the IDX’s top gainer for the week. The exchange has temporarily suspended trading in the shares. Hakimson Growth Capital and a company owned by Gabriel Rey previously acquired a combined 20% stake at Rp428 a share; Andry Hakim said they have undisclosed plans for the company and an agreement allows their ownership to potentially increase.

earnings_guidance.event: Bank Mandiri reports nine-month 2026 earnings and broker target-price reactions
earnings_guidance.headline: BMRI reports Rp45.5 trillion nine-month profit as brokers set target prices
earnings_guidance.blurb: Bank Mandiri’s profit rose 20.7% year on year. Samuel Sekuritas maintained its buy rating and Rp4,900 target, implying 25.6% upside, while Sucor Sekuritas maintained hold and raised its target to Rp4,350.

earnings_guidance.headline: PTSN reports H1 2026 revenue up 65.2% to US$182.28 million
earnings_guidance.blurb: Sat Nusapersada's gross margin narrowed to 8.1% from 13.9%, and pre-tax profit fell to US$6.13 million from US$8.64 million. MNC Sekuritas analyst Herditya Wicaksana said a PBV below 1x does not automatically mean the shares are undervalued.

earnings_guidance.headline: UVCR reports 395.8% net profit growth to Rp10.63 billion
earnings_guidance.blurb: Ultra Voucher’s sales rose 37.94% to Rp917.99 billion, while earnings per share increased to Rp5.31 from Rp1.07. The company is preparing a private placement of up to 200 million shares, subject to approval at an extraordinary general meeting planned for 27 October. Proceeds would mainly fund working capital, development, operations and marketing.
